row: Welcome to my channel. It has educational videos but also information about our indie project and game modes for DGGFV which will launch in July 2026. DGGFV is a single and multiplayer, veterinary-themed 3D board game that turns studying clinical medicine into an engaging adventure. Featuring a charming voxel-art style packed with adorable dogs and customizable vet characters, the game challenges players' medical knowledge using dynamic, generated clinical cases and questions. Players navigate the board to tackle medical scenarios, track their progress, and unlock new skins, seamlessly blending competitive gaming with real-world veterinary science. Game will continue to update and hopefully have more game modes (aside from the board game), in addition to raffles and other exciting things!
